notes.title: Mayhem's Adventure 1.8
notes.content:
Mayhem's Adventure 1.8

Added

 -added lots more achievements, and made it possible to achieve all of them.
 -fixed many bugs, if you find one, please make a post on the community
 -made the game easier to run, yes, i know it's a 2D game...
 -added a mobile build that you can switch too if you would prefer it.
 -added DLC support, will be coming in future...

notes.title: Update 1.5
notes.content:
Added Tons of new features and a few bugfixes!

New Content
- 4 New Secret Levels
- Second Player Added
- Added More Lore Content
- Added Occasional Effects
- Added Skip Level Option (Located In Menu When You Click Logo In Bottom Right)
- Added Statistics menu (Includes: Time, Deaths, And Skips)

Bugfixes
- Made Game Load Slightly Faster
- Fixed Start Button Activating Multiple Times
- Fixed Pause Menu Opening Multiple Times

Thanks For Playing The Game And Have Fun!
